name: Welcome to the [unofficial] Washiez Community Hub!
desc:
**Washiez Promotion Logs**
Founded by Anna & Mila

> This board is **unofficial** and is maintained only for fun. Based on EST/EDT.

Welcome to the Trello Board where we log **current/former Management+ members and Staff of the Week**. This initially started as a small, little idea that we sparked together. We thought it would be awesome to see how our fellow Washians progress through their journey in this massive group, so we kicked off with the creation of this Trello board on **July 31st, 2023**!

As of **January 4th, 2026**, the Community Hub is now ran and owned by antvonys and Differentduc, our goal is to keep the board up to date and within the Washiez community with the help of our Board Members.

**Disclaimer:** Not all information is correct/included; however, we try to provide as much information as we can and as accurately as possible. Should there be any edits needed for the card, please reach out to a Board Member. If you have any concerns about the board's technicalities—or if you would like to become a member of our staff team—feel free to reach out through our Discord server.
